title: Local Complexity, Overlap Control, and Global Simplicity in Partition Graphs: A Conceptual Synthesis for G_n and K_n = Cl(G_n)
summary: For each positive integer $n$, let $G_n$ be the partition graph whose vertices are the partitions of $n$, with adjacency defined by an elementary transfer of one unit between parts, followed by reordering. Let $K_n=\mathrm{Cl}(G_n)$ be its clique complex. Previous work revealed two apparently contrasting features of this family. Locally, the graphs $G_n$ become increasingly rich: local clique dimensions grow, degree landscapes refine, support jumps and simplex layers proliferate, and axial, rear, central, shell, and directional structures become more pronounced.
